To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a concerned citizen regarding the upcoming appearance of Jeffrey D. Zehr, 45, of Pulaski/Sandy Creek, in Oswego County CAP Court on May 9, 2026, at 5:30 p.m.

On April 25, 2026, New York State Police arrested Zehr on 40 counts of Torturing or Injuring Animals/Failure to Provide Proper Sustenance (Class A misdemeanor, NY Agriculture & Markets Law §353) plus one count of Criminal Possession of a Weapon in the 4th Degree (Class A misdemeanor). This followed the removal of approximately 140 neglected animals (horses, sheep, goats, cows, cats, chickens, and a Great Dane) from his 87-acre property in Sandy Creek. The conditions were so severe the residence was declared unfit for human occupancy by code enforcement.

In 2019 in Jefferson County he was charged with 14 counts, pleaded guilty, and received 50 weekends in jail.

Treating even this repeated, multi-property, large-scale neglect as misdemeanors (maximum one year per count, often far less in practice) is a slap in the face of justice. It provides virtually no deterrent for repeat offenders like Zehr, while rescues, the Oswego County SPCA, and taxpayers bear enormous costs and the animals endure prolonged suffering.

We respectfully urge your office to:

1: Seek the maximum penalties on every count, with jail time served consecutively where legally possible.
2: Recommend full forfeiture of all animals and a lifetime ban on Zehr owning, possessing, or residing with any animals.
3: Aggressively prosecute the weapons charge in light of his prior felony conviction.

A strong sentencing recommendation will demonstrate that Oswego County takes repeated animal cruelty seriously and will help break the cycle. We are happy to provide victim impact statements from the rescues caring for the 140 survivors or any other assistance your office may need.

Thank you for your leadership in protecting the most vulnerable. We look forward to real justice being served.

I am writing to formally report animal cruelty by Douglass Bess Jr. (also known as SoFresh Dinero or To The Bag/ImFresh Dinero), who is believed to reside at 440 E Cambridge Ave, Fresno, CA 93704. Mr. Bess has publicly recorded and shared video footage of himself physically abusing his dog Kasanova, while describing the acts as “discipline.”

This behavior is not only a clear violation of California Penal Code 597 (animal cruelty), but it also raises serious public safety concerns due to the well-established link between animal abuse and violence toward humans. According to the FBI, animal cruelty is now tracked in the National Incident-Based Reporting System (NIBRS) precisely because research consistently shows it is a strong predictor and co-occurring factor with other violent crimes, including assault, domestic violence, rape, murder, and child abuse. Landmark studies, such as the 1997 Massachusetts SPCA/Northeastern University research, have found that individuals who abuse animals are five times more likely to commit violent crimes against humans. Additional data from the FBI and law enforcement analyses indicate that a significant percentage of animal abusers (often cited around 70%) have other reported incidents of violent behavior.

Given Mr. Bess’s public platform and the visibility of this content, a thorough investigation is warranted not only to protect the animals involved but also to assess any potential risk to the broader community.

I respectfully request that the Fresno Police Department open an investigation into this matter.

Thank you for your attention to this important report and for your continued efforts to protect both animals and the residents of Fresno.

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to demand immediate accountability for the actions of a San Bernardino County Sheriff's deputy on May 4, 2026, at approximately 11:37 a.m. on the 7000 block of Glasgow Avenue in San Bernardino.

Surveillance footage which has been reviewed by KTLA and is now circulating widely shows a male deputy opening the gate to homeowner Jesus Serna's private, fenced backyard without a warrant, without the owner's consent, and without any lawful basis to enter. The deputy was investigating a stolen vehicle that, per reporting, had no connection whatsoever to Mr. Serna or his property.

Upon entering the yard, the deputy encountered Daisy, Mr. Serna's rottweiler, who barked and approached him, a natural, expected response from a dog defending her home from an uninvited intruder. The deputy shot and killed her.

The entry was unlawful. The shooting was the direct consequence of that unlawful entry. A family's dog is dead because a deputy chose to open a gate he had no legal right to open.

I am demanding the following:

1. TERMINATION of the deputy responsible for the unlawful entry and shooting, pending the outcome of a full independent investigation.
2. CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION by the District Attorney's Office into whether the deputy's conduct constitutes criminal trespass and/or unlawful destruction of property under California law.
3. FULL RESTITUTION to Mr. Serna of the approximately $250 in shelter fees he was forced to pay to retrieve his surviving dog, Raven, a dog that was removed from private property without cause and impounded at his expense. That Mr. Serna was charged any amount for the retrieval of his own dog, seized from his own yard during an unlawful search, is an outrage that compounds the original misconduct.
4. A PUBLIC STATEMENT from the Sheriff's Department confirming what has been reported by KTLA, that the stolen vehicle bore no connection to Mr. Serna's property, and a full explanation of what legal authority the deputy believed he had to enter that yard.

The surveillance footage is unambiguous. The public is watching, and the standard of accountability we accept here will set the precedent for what officers in this county believe they are permitted to do.

I urge you to act swiftly and transparently.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BZOUETlAH3u8eum8mUO9jN8FqVb3_rXd/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team

Subject: Formal complaint, Animal Control officer conduct, April 21, Merchant Terrace, Deltona

I am writing to make a formal complaint regarding an incident that took place on April 21st at approximately 10am at a residential address on Merchant Terrace, Deltona.

A uniformed City of Deltona Animal Control officer was filmed catchpoling a cat and dragging it along the ground while the animal was in visible distress. It is believed this cat was one of approximately 40 animals involved in a recent hoarding case at the same address. Given the already severe stress these animals have endured, the officer's conduct made an already traumatic situation significantly worse. Her actions served no legitimate animal welfare purpose and may constitute an offence under Florida Statute §828.12.

I am formally requesting:

1. The immediate removal of this officer from active duty pending investigation
2. A formal investigation into her conduct
3. A public statement from the city addressing this incident
4. A review of Animal Control training, oversight, and TNR protocol compliance

links.title: Justice for Liberty
links.mailtoSubject: Documented Neglect Case, Named Owner, No Charges: Staten Island DA Sitting on It for 3 Months
links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

A German Shepherd named Liberty was surrendered in late February 2026 after nearly five years of neglect under her owner, Moe Elmasry, on Staten Island. She arrived at Broken Souls Rescue & Recovery severely emaciated. Nearly three months of intensive veterinary care later, she is only now approaching a healthy weight.

The surrender was captured on video. In it, Elmasry states he is responsible for Liberty and that she was "living a good life." Veterinary records document what that life actually looked like.

Neighbor complaints had prompted prior police visits. Each time, no action was taken. The outdoor kennel setup was apparently deemed legal despite Liberty's condition.

The rescue organization, Pitbulls & Addicts (pitbullsandaddicts.org), has documented Liberty's full recovery on social media and has been publicly calling for accountability since late February. The story has tens of thousands of engagements but no press coverage.

The owner is named and on camera. The veterinary record exists.

The Richmond County DA's Office, which has a dedicated and tax payer funded Animal Cruelty Prosecution Unit, has not announced charges, an arrest, or an investigation in the nearly three months since the rescue. DA McMahon's created the division precisely for cases like this one. I am respectfully asking that it be used:

1: That a formal investigation into this case be opened under NY Agriculture & Markets Law §353
2: That the documented veterinary evidence of Liberty's condition at intake be formally reviewed
3: That the pattern of prior complaints and police visits with no resulting action be examined as part of that investigation

Liberty survived. The person responsible is known, on camera, and on record. What is needed now is accountability.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.title: Demand Accountability From Compton Mayor
links.mailtoSubject: Public Accountability: Animal Neglect, Blocked Advocates, and the 2026 Election
links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a concerned citizen regarding the ongoing stray dog, animal neglect, and cruelty issues in our city.
According to the latest available data, approximately 57% of Compton households own pets, roughly 13,734 pet-owning households and about 9,628 dog-owning ones. This represents a significant portion of our community that expects basic public safety and animal welfare protections.

Despite this, visible problems persist: loose and aggressive dogs, reports of neglect and abuse, and slow response times from county animal control. Animal advocates, including Joey Tuccio of Starts With One Today, have publicly called attention to these issues and documented cases on Compton streets, only to be blocked by your office on social media and have critical comments removed. This does not reflect open, responsive leadership.

Compton residents deserve concrete action, not silence or suppression of advocacy. We respectfully request that your administration:

1: Immediately strengthen coordination and funding partnerships with LA County DACC for faster response, spay/neuter programs, and enforcement in Compton.
2: Launch a city-backed public education and low-cost spay/neuter campaign targeted at our high pet-owning population.
3: Direct the Public Safety Commission and Code Enforcement to treat animal neglect as the public safety and quality-of-life issue it is.
4: Commit to transparency by holding a public town hall or council item on animal welfare before the June 2026 election.
5: A public statement issued by Mayor Sharif and the Compton City Council, posted on the city’s official website and all official social media channels that fully addresses these issues and commits to the actions listed above.

Many of us will be evaluating records on this issue as we head into the election cycle. A strong response now would demonstrate real leadership for all Compton families, including the thousands with pets.



Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

Como abogada con más de 20 años de experiencia en derecho público y patrimonial, se presume que conoce perfectamente las protecciones legales de los animales en la Ciudad de México.

Solicito respetuosamente que:

1: Abran inmediatamente una investigación oficial sobre este incidente.
2: Asigne un número de caso o expediente.

4: Aplique las sanciones administrativas o penales correspondientes de conformidad con la ley.

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a concerned citizen regarding the recent dismissal of animal cruelty charges against Maddison Eastman, a dog trainer from Methuen who operates a kennel and training facility. On May 12, 2026, a Lawrence District Court judge dismissed the two counts of animal cruelty against her because prosecutors were not ready to proceed. This case involved a widely circulated video showing her striking two German Shepherds (Lilo and Gus) with a PVC pipe.

Dropping these charges is a profound slap in the face to justice and to everyone who cares about animal welfare and community safety. It sends a dangerous message that clear evidence of animal abuse can be set aside without consequence.

The well-documented link between animal abuse and violent crime makes this dismissal particularly alarming. Multiple studies, including research from the Massachusetts SPCA and Northeastern University, show that individuals who commit animal cruelty are five times more likely to commit violent crimes against humans. FBI and other law enforcement analyses consistently identify animal abuse as a predictor or co-occurring factor with domestic violence, child abuse, and other interpersonal violence. In one review, a significant percentage of animal cruelty offenders also had histories of battery or other violent offenses.

Allowing this case to be dismissed without vigorous prosecution potentially endangers the community, especially animals in her care and any people who interact with her professionally or personally. Former clients have reportedly come forward with additional concerns, raising broader red flags about patterns of behavior.

The key failure appears to be reliance on Eastman’s ex-boyfriend, Christian Duran (who recorded the video and faces his own animal cruelty charge), to authenticate the recording. Prosecutors could have easily used a digital forensics team to authenticate the video through metadata analysis, hash verification for tampering, and expert testimony, methods that are fully accepted under Massachusetts evidence rules (Guide to Evidence §§ 901 and 1119) and routinely used for cell phone videos. Instead of securing Duran’s testimony via immunity or a plea deal, or pivoting to forensics, they let the case collapse. This was a preventable prosecutorial shortfall.

I respectfully urge your office, through the Criminal Bureau, to review this case for possible refiling or further investigation. Prosecutorial discretion should not come at the expense of public safety or accountability for blatant violations caught on video.

Thank you for your attention to this important matter.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iqQczQ7mUfrjeke-MkS1Q-YTiqxpY-El/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to report a welfare incident at Romford Greyhound Stadium on 11th May 2026, to raise concerns about the apparent failure to report it under GBGB Rules of Racing, and to flag a fundamental conflict of interest at the heart of the GBGB.

During the live Premier Greyhound Racing broadcast of Race 4, 12:01, Grade A8 at Romford on 11th May 2026, a greyhound collapsed and appeared to seize or have a heart attack on the far side of the track post-race. The incident is captured on broadcast at timestamp 12:01:56, with race details and PGR branding clearly visible.

The dog is Roaming Tinder, winner of the race. Trained by Marlene Westwood, owned by Mr R G Batten.

The replay at https://greyhounds1.attheraces.com/video/replay/389131 cannot be viewed. Races 3 and 5 from the same meeting play normally. Race 4 alone returns this server-side response:

"ERROR RETURNED | INVALID_EVENT_ID ~ EventID is missing or invalid."

Strongly indicating that the event has been actively invalidated.

I request the following:

1: A public statement confirming whether a trackside vet report was filed for this incident as required under GBGB Rules of Racing.
2: A public statement confirming whether Romford's injury register contains an entry for 11th May 2026 relating to Roaming Tinder.
3: A public explanation for why the Race 4 replay has been server-side invalidated while adjacent races remain accessible.
4: An immediate welfare check on Roaming Tinder and Marlene Westwood's 23 other dogs at her kennels, with the outcome publicly reported.

GBGB Chairman Sir Philip Davies recently wrote in the Racing Post: "To be clear, none of the arguments against our sport are grounded in evidence." This complaint is grounded in evidence.

More critically: Sir Philip simultaneously chairs Star Sports Group, a bookmaker which owns Star Pelaw, a GBGB-licensed track that the GBGB is responsible for inspecting and licensing. The chairman of the regulator has a direct financial interest in a track he regulates. The GBGB's own Impartiality Committee requires members to have no direct links to tracks. Their chairman is held to a lower standard than the committee beneath him.

DEFRA and DCMS must confirm publicly whether this dual role was assessed prior to Sir Philip's appointment and whether it is compatible with the GBGB's obligations as an independent regulatory body. UKAS must confirm publicly whether it is compatible with the ISO 17065 accreditation the GBGB holds.

A dog seized on live television. The footage was deleted. No welfare report appears to have been filed. The regulator's chairman has a financial stake in the industry he regulates and has publicly dismissed all welfare concerns as baseless.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XToSX5gtdWySnL5unOrCfmm4z97vcjX2/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to report suspected animal cruelty at 525 Rose Street, Chester, PA 19013. A resident allegedly named Lauren Carter has been observed walking outside her property and pouring bleach directly onto food that is regularly left out for stray cats in the neighborhood. This is a clear and deliberate act intended to poison or harm the animals.

By deliberately exposing the stray cats to bleach, a toxic, corrosive substance, on their food source, the individual has placed the animals at imminent risk of serious bodily injury (including chemical burns, poisoning, or death), making this a misdemeanor of the second degree under §5533(b)(2). Should any cats suffer serious injury or death as a result, this may further constitute aggravated cruelty under 18 Pa.C.S. §5534, a felony of the third degree.

I respectfully request that your agency open an immediate investigation and take all appropriate enforcement action under these statutes. I also ask that the public be kept updated via a public statement once action is taken. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

إلى من يهمه الأمر،

أكتب إليكم بصفتي أحد أفراد الرأي العام الدولي المهتمين بالأمر، لأطالب رسمياً السلطات اللبنانية بفتح إجراءات جنائية ضد سمير شرف الدين بموجب قانون حماية ورفاهية الحيوانات رقم 47 لعام 2017.

في 18 أو 19 مايو 2026 أو في تاريخ قريب من ذلك، انتشرت أدلة فيديو علنًا تظهر السيد شرف الدين وهو يربط كلبًا بسيارته ويجر الحيوان عبر شوارع عازونية، في منطقة عالي. يشكل هذا السلوك انتهاكًا واضحًا للقانون رقم 47/2017، الذي يحظر إساءة معاملة الحيوانات ويفرض عقوبات تشمل السجن.

وبدلاً من أن يخضع للتحقيق، رفع السيد شرف الدين شكاوى جنائية بتهمة التشهير والتحريض على المشاعر الدينية ضد الناشطة غينا ناهفاوي، التي نشرت مقطع الفيديو الذي يوثق الإساءة. وتم احتجاز السيدة ناهفاوي لاحقاً. وتمثل هذه السلسلة من الأحداث فشلاً ذريعاً للنظام القانوني اللبناني في تطبيق قوانينه بشكل منصف.

أدلة الفيديو موثقة ومتاحة للجمهور. وهوية الجاني ليست موضع نزاع. والقانون رقم 47/2017 موجود تحديداً للتعامل مع سلوك من هذا النوع.

لذلك نطالب بما يلي:
1. فتح تحقيق رسمي ضد سمير شرف الدين بموجب القانون رقم 47/2017 دون مزيد من التأخير.
2. إسقاط الدعوى المرفوعة بتهمة التشهير ضد غينا ناهفاوي، والتي نشأت مباشرة عن توثيقها للاعتداء المزعوم، بالكامل.
3. أن تؤكد السلطات اللبنانية، من خلال أفعالها، أن قانون رعاية الحيوانات ينطبق على جميع الأشخاص بغض النظر عن مناصبهم أو انتماءاتهم الدينية.

دليل بالفيديو: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jvuIevZy8LFfEM_SQENHAuXdZSWWOR0r/view?usp=sharing

مع خالص التقدير،



فريق @HallieForAnimals
contact@hallieforanimals.org



To whom it may concern,

I write as a concerned member of the international public to formally demand that Lebanese authorities initiate criminal proceedings against Samir Sharaf al-Din under Lebanon's Animal Protection and Welfare Law No. 47 of 2017.

On or around 18–19 May 2026, video evidence circulated publicly depicting Mr. Sharaf al-Din tying a dog to his vehicle and dragging the animal through the streets of Azzounieh, Aley district. This conduct constitutes a clear violation of Law 47/2017, which prohibits the abuse and mistreatment of animals and carries penalties including imprisonment.

Instead of facing investigation, Mr. Sharaf al-Din filed criminal complaints of defamation and incitement of religious sentiment against activist Ghina Nahfawi, who posted the footage documenting the abuse. Ms. Nahfawi was subsequently detained. This sequence of events represents a profound failure of Lebanon's legal system to apply its own laws equitably.

The video evidence is documented and publicly available. The identity of the perpetrator is not in dispute. Law 47/2017 exists precisely to address conduct of this nature.

We therefore demand:
1. That a formal investigation be opened against Samir Sharaf al-Din under Law 47/2017 without further delay.
2. That the defamation complaint filed against Ghina Nahfawi, which arose directly from her documentation of the alleged abuse, be dropped in its entirety.
3. That Lebanese authorities affirm, through action, that animal welfare law applies to all persons regardless of title or religious standing.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jvuIevZy8LFfEM_SQENHAuXdZSWWOR0r/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
A quien corresponda,

Les escribo para exigir que se lleve a cabo la investigación más exhaustiva posible y se procese a la persona responsable del atroz acto de maltrato animal ocurrido el 21 de mayo de 2026 en Alalpardo.
Un gato callejero quedó atrapado deliberadamente en una gigantesca trampa de acero oxidada, del tipo «pinza para patas», colocada detrás de los barrotes de una ventana a pie de calle, sobre un saliente de piedra de acceso público.
El gato sufrió lesiones catastróficas, perdió grandes cantidades de sangre y murió a pesar de la rápida intervención del veterinario y de los vecinos.

Perseguir este caso con todo el peso de la ley (Ley 7/2023 de protección de los animales y el Código Penal) es esencial no solo para hacer justicia a la víctima, sino también para la seguridad pública. Las investigaciones europeas muestran claramente el «vínculo» bien establecido entre el maltrato animal y la violencia humana: la Fundación Naturewatch del Reino Unido y The Links Group han documentado que la crueldad hacia los animales es con frecuencia un precursor de los delitos violentos contra las personas y una herramienta de control coercitivo en el maltrato doméstico (pruebas de la Fundación Naturewatch ante el Parlamento del Reino Unido, 2023). En estudios criminológicos de toda la UE aparecen conclusiones similares. No actuar transmite el peligroso mensaje de que se tolera tal barbarie.

Le insto respetuosamente a que identifique rápidamente al autor, trate este asunto como un delito grave y mantenga al público informado de los avances. Miles de ciudadanos de toda España y Europa están pendientes y apoyarán cualquier acción legal que sea necesaria.

Gracias por su atención inmediata y por la respuesta compasiva ya mostrada en el lugar de los hechos.

Pruebas en vídeo: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14PIJ0KdiYh7mIka9g4JIJ__MZdec6N3v/view?usp=sharing

Atentamente,



Equipo de @HallieForAnimals
contact@hallieforanimals.org




To whom it may concern,

I am writing to demand the strongest possible investigation and prosecution of the person responsible for the horrific animal cruelty that occurred on May 21st 2026, in Alalpardo.
A community cat was deliberately trapped in a gigantic, rusty steel-jaw leg-hold trap placed behind the bars of a street-level window on a public-access stone ledge.
The cat suffered catastrophic injuries, lost massive amounts of blood, and died despite the rapid response by the vet and neighbours.

Prosecuting this case to the fullest extent of the law (Ley 7/2023 de protección de los animales and the Código Penal) is essential not only for justice for the victim but for public safety. European research clearly shows the well-established “Link” between animal abuse and human violence: the UK’s Naturewatch Foundation and The Links Group have documented that animal cruelty is frequently a precursor to violent offending against people and a tool of coercive control in domestic abuse (Naturewatch Foundation evidence to UK Parliament, 2023). Similar findings appear in criminological studies across the EU. Failing to act sends the dangerous message that such barbarity is tolerated.

I respectfully urge you to identify the perpetrator quickly, treat this as a serious criminal matter, and keep the public informed of progress. Thousands of citizens across Spain and Europe are watching and will support any legal action required.

Thank you for your immediate attention and for the compassionate response already shown on scene.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14PIJ0KdiYh7mIka9g4JIJ__MZdec6N3v/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

أكتب إليكم بصفتي مواطناً يشعر بقلق بالغ، لأعرب عن غضبي الشديد وأطالب بالتحقيق الفوري ومقاضاة مرتكبي عمل وحشي من أعمال القسوة على الحيوانات، وقع في مجمع ”دار مصر“ السكني، الدائرة 16، مدينة الشيخ زايد، محافظة الجيزة. وتُظهر مقاطع فيديو منتشرة على نطاق واسع امرأة مسنة وهي تضع جرواً صغيراً داخل سلة قمامة ذات عجلات، حيث توجد بالفعل عدة جراء أخرى مرمية بداخلها.

هذا الحادث جزء من نمط أوسع من الممارسات اللاإنسانية والبغيضة تمامًا المتمثلة في إزالة الكلاب الضالة من الشوارع في نطاق سلطتكم — باستخدام المشابك الحديدية، والضرب، ودهسها، وغيرها من أعمال العنف المتعمد. مثل هذه الأفعال غير أخلاقية وتشكل وصمة عار عميقة على ضمير أمة عريقة وغنية ثقافيًا وذات أهمية تاريخية مثل مصر. إن الحضارة التي قدمت للعالم آلاف السنين من الحكمة والفن والعلوم واحترام الحياة لا يمكنها، بضمير حي، أن تتسامح مع سوء المعاملة الجماعية للحيوانات الحية بهذه الطريقة أو تسمح بها. هذا لا يعكس ما يجب أن تسعى مصر إلى أن تكون عليه في العصر الحديث. إنه أمر مخزٍ ومتخلف ولا يتوافق مع أي ادعاء بالإنسانية أو التقدم أو التراث الفخور الذي تدعيه مصر.

تؤكد الأبحاث المصرية خطورة السماح باستمرار مثل هذه القسوة. فقد أثبتت دراسة أجرتها الجامعة الأمريكية بالقاهرة عام 2022 حول إساءة معاملة الحيوانات في مصر، إلى جانب تحليلات خبراء مصريين في الطب البيطري وعلم الاجتماع، وجود صلة مباشرة بين القسوة على الحيوانات والجرائم العنيفة المستقبلية ضد البشر، بما في ذلك العنف المنزلي والعدوان بين الأفراد. وقد أعلنت النيابة العامة نفسها مرارًا وتكرارًا أن إيذاء الحيوانات جريمة يعاقب عليها القانون المصري والدين والأخلاق.

يجب إنهاء هذه الممارسات الآن.

1: التحقيق الفوري ومقاضاة المسؤولين عن حادثة صندوق القمامة في دار مصر بموجب أحكام القسوة على الحيوانات.
2: وقف جميع العقود أو التصاريح أو الموافقات الضمنية الممنوحة لشركات مكافحة الآفات الخاصة أو الأفراد التي تؤدي إلى مثل هذه الوحشية.
3: التحول حصريًا إلى الأساليب الإنسانية القائمة على الأدلة، مثل برامج ”الاصطياد والتعقيم والتلقيح والإعادة“ (TNVR)، بما يتوافق تمامًا مع أهداف مصر الوطنية لمكافحة داء الكلب وإدارة الحيوانات الضالة.
4: إجراء تحقيق شامل في عمليات الإزالة العنيفة الجارية ومحاسبة المسؤولين عنها.

إن عدم التصرف بسرعة لن يؤدي إلا إلى تضخيم الغضب المحلي والإدانة الدولية مع استمرار انتشار هذه الحوادث عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي وشبكات حماية الحيوانات.
أحثكم على التعامل مع هذه المسألة بالسرعة والجدية التي تتطلبها. إن تاريخ مصر نفسه وأعين العالم تراقبون.

دليل بالفيديو: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1g1v1j57ypK-h7MKurkqrwYZBSxNcg5V6/view?usp=sharing

مع خالص التقدير،



فريق @HallieForAnimals
contact@hallieforanimals.org



To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a deeply concerned individual to express my absolute outrage and to demand the immediate investigation and prosecution of a barbaric act of animal cruelty that took place in Dar Misr residential compound, District 16, Sheikh Zayed City, Giza Governorate. Videos circulating widely show an elderly woman placing a puppy into a wheelie bin, with several other puppies already discarded inside it.

This incident is part of a wider pattern of inhumane and utterly abhorrent practices of violently removing stray dogs from the streets in your jurisdiction — using iron clamps, beatings, running them over, and other acts of deliberate thuggery. Such actions are immoral and a profound stain on the conscience of a nation as ancient, culturally rich, and historically significant as Egypt. A civilization that gave the world millennia of wisdom, art, science, and reverence for life cannot, in good conscience, tolerate or enable the mass mistreatment of sentient animals in this manner. This does not reflect what Egypt should strive to be in the modern era. It is shameful, backward, and incompatible with any claim to humanity, progress, or the proud heritage Egypt claims.

Egyptian research confirms the danger of allowing such cruelty to continue. A 2022 study from the American University in Cairo on animal abuse in Egypt, along with analyses by Egyptian veterinary and sociology experts, has established a direct link between cruelty to animals and future violent crimes against humans, including domestic violence and interpersonal aggression. The Public Prosecution has itself repeatedly declared that harming animals is a punishable crime under Egyptian law, religion, and ethics.

These practices must end NOW.

1: Immediately investigate and prosecute those responsible for the Dar Misr wheelie-bin incident under animal cruelty provisions.
2: Cease all contracts, permissions, or tacit approvals granted to private pest control companies or individuals that result in such brutality.
3: Shift exclusively to humane, evidence-based methods such as Trap-Neuter-Vaccinate-Return (TNVR) programs, in full alignment with Egypt’s own national rabies-control and stray animal management goals.
4: Launch a thorough investigation into ongoing violent removal operations and hold those responsible accountable.

Failure to act swiftly will only amplify domestic outrage and international condemnation as these incidents continue to spread across social media and animal protection networks.
I urge you to treat this matter with the urgency and seriousness it demands. Egypt’s own history and the eyes of the world are watching.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1g1v1j57ypK-h7MKurkqrwYZBSxNcg5V6/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a concerned citizen to formally demand immediate criminal prosecution in the April 17, 2026 animal cruelty case in Lincolnton, Georgia.
According to the official police report and bodycam footage:

Lizzy Long shot an owned pet cat with a shotgun while the cat was hiding behind a garage and posed no imminent threat.
The cat suffered for at least three minutes after the shot before dying.
Mayor Mike McCombs actively encouraged and urged his wife to carry out the shooting.
The cat’s owner participated after asking the responding officer whether he was breaking any laws.

Officer bodycam captured the entire sequence, including the non-humane method that caused unnecessary suffering. This clearly violates Georgia animal cruelty statutes (O.C.G.A. § 16-12-4). The Georgia Department of Agriculture previously issued (then recalled) a warrant for aggravated animal cruelty against Lizzy Long, confirming the seriousness of the case.
I respectfully demand that your offices take the following actions without further delay:

1: File criminal charges against Lizzy Long for aggravated animal cruelty.
2: File charges against Mayor Mike McCombs for aiding and abetting the cruelty.
3: File charges against the cat’s owner for his role in the incident.
4: The Lincolnton City Council must immediately remove Mayor McCombs from office, as an elected official who encouraged animal cruelty has no place in leadership.

The public is watching how this case is handled — especially given the direct involvement of the mayor. The bodycam footage and police report are already public through local news (WRDW) and Alley Cat Allies.

Thank you for upholding the law and ensuring justice for this animal.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lvPTNKCQAoYhEFqBHfMX-SoyWB3tC4Od/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

To whom it may concern,

I am writing to demand an immediate animal welfare check at The Grove apartment complex, 4101 E Rancier Ave, Killeen, TX 76543.

A resident at this address has been recorded on doorbell camera footage striking their dog in the parking lot. This footage documents a clear, deliberate act of physical abuse against an animal.

It is our understanding that the Killeen Police Department has already been made aware of this footage and has declined to act.

Striking a dog constitutes cruelty to a nonlivestock animal under Texas Penal Code §42.092, a criminal offense carrying up to a year in county jail and a $4,000 fine. The animal in question remains at this address and is at ongoing risk.

We are asking for the following:

1. An immediate welfare check at the above address.
2. A formal review of the existing doorbell cam footage as evidence.
3. The department's response via public statement.

Chief Lopez has spoken publicly about his commitment to accountability and transparency, and his background in internal affairs. We are taking him at his word. An officer declining to act on documented animal abuse, footage already in hand, is not a grey area. It is a failure of duty under Texas law, and it is the kind of conduct that reflects on this department's leadership.

The animal cannot speak for itself. We are here because someone has to.

We will continue to apply public pressure until this case receives the response it legally and morally demands.

To whom it may concern,

I am writing to formally request a prompt investigation into an incident of alleged animal cruelty at Charming Puppy Cuts, a dog grooming salon located at 2103 Whitehorse Mercerville Rd #6, Hamilton Township, NJ 08619, operated by Charmin (or Charmin Rodriguez).

A publicly available (and linked below) video depicts the owner handling a dog in a manner that includes rough physical treatment and verbal aggression, with the dog showing clear signs of fear and distress on the grooming table. This occurred in a commercial setting where pets are entrusted for care.

Animal cruelty is not an isolated issue. Extensive research demonstrates a well-documented link between animal abuse and violent crimes against humans: individuals who abuse animals are significantly more likely to commit interpersonal violence, including assault, domestic abuse, and other serious offenses. Studies, such as one by the Massachusetts SPCA and Northeastern University, indicate animal abusers are five times more likely to harm humans. This correlation underscores the public safety imperative for thorough investigation.

I urge your office to review the video evidence, interview witnesses/staff/clients, inspect the premises, and take appropriate enforcement action under New Jersey animal cruelty statutes. Please confirm receipt and provide a case number or update on next steps.

Thank you for prioritizing animal welfare and community safety.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1PpF90AaXsPnDuHVkVAjGk2fXrt3Z_D5U/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
Dear District Attorney Rouse,

I'm writing about Commonwealth v. Lauren Ashley Carter of Chester — two counts of cruelty to animals under 18 Pa.C.S. §5533, with arraignment on June 29.

I understand the misdemeanor grade fits the facts: with no animal having ingested the bleach, aggravated cruelty under §5534 is a hard fit, since it requires torture as narrowly defined or serious injury or death. I'm not asking for a charge the facts can't bear.

But Ms. Carter admitted to pouring bleach on food left for a neighborhood cat colony on two separate occasions. That is deliberate and repeated, and no animal died by luck rather than restraint. I'd urge the office to weigh attempted aggravated cruelty under §901, which exists precisely for intended harm that doesn't land.

Whatever the grade: please prosecute the § 5533 counts fully, oppose any ARD or diversion, and seek an ownership prohibition and forfeiture under § 5560.

Thank you for upholding the law in this case.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.title: Protect Moroccan Street Dogs
links.mailtoSubject: Urgent Appeal – Halt the Mass Killing of Street Dogs in Morocco Ahead of FIFA 2030/ نداء عاجل – وقف القتل الجماعي للكلاب الضالة في المغرب قبل كأس العالم 2030
links.mailtoBody:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing with urgent concern regarding the systematic and brutal killing of street dogs currently unfolding across Morocco, actions reportedly linked to preparations for the 2030 FIFA World Cup.

Shocking footage and eyewitness accounts reveal dogs being poisoned, shot, and discarded like trash. These killings are not only acts of cruelty—they are a humanitarian crisis in plain sight. If allowed to continue, they will stain Morocco’s reputation on the global stage and betray the very values of unity, dignity, and compassion that the World Cup is meant to embody.

This is a critical moment. Morocco can either stand as a model of humane progress or be remembered for silencing its stray population in cold blood before the games even begin.

We respectfully urge:

An immediate and total halt to the killing of street dogs.

The nationwide implementation of TNVR (Trap, Neuter, Vaccinate, Release) programs.

Collaboration with local and international animal welfare experts to develop ethical, sustainable solutions.

Morocco has the opportunity to lead by example—to show that greatness is measured not only in stadiums and goals, but in how a nation treats its most vulnerable. The world is watching. History is recording.

Please act now, before more innocent lives are lost, and the shadow of these killings becomes the defining image of Morocco’s World Cup legacy.

Sincerely,



السلام عليكم،

كنكتب ليكم بقلق كبير وبحالة استعجال على قتل الكلاب الضالة اللي واقع دابا في المغرب بطريقة وحشية ومنظمة، وكيقولوا أنها مرتبطة بتحضيرات كأس العالم 2030.

كاين فيديوهات وشهادات كتورينا الكلاب كتتسمم، كتضرب بالرصاص وكتترك تموت في الشوارع بحال شي حاجة ما عندها حتى قيمة. هاد التصرفات ماشي غير قسوة على الحيوانات، بل كارثة إنسانية كبيرة. إلى بقات هاد الحالة مستمرة، غادي تجرح سمعة المغرب قدام العالم وتناقض القيم ديال التضامن، الكرامة، والرحمة اللي خاص يكونو حاضرين فهاد الحدث العالمي.

هاد اللحظة مهمة بزاف. المغرب قدامو خيارين: يا إما يكون مثال للتقدم والإنسانية، يا إما يكون معروف بأنه قتّل كلبانو في دم بارد قبل ما تبدا المباريات.

كنطالبوا بكل احترام:

وقف فوري وشامل لقتل الكلاب الضالة.

تطبيق برامج التحصين، التعقيم، والإطلاق (TNVR) في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

التعاون مع جمعيات حماية الحيوان المحلية والدولية باش يلقاو حلول أخلاقية ومستدامة.

المغرب عندو الفرصة باش يورّي العالم باللي العظمة ماشي غير في الملاعب والنتائج، ولكن في كيفاش كيتعامل مع أضعف مخلوقاتو. العالم كيتفرج، والتاريخ غادي يسجل.

رجاءً تحركوا دابا، قبل ما تفقدو أرواح بريئة، وما توليش صورة هاد القتل هي اللي غادي تبقى فذاكرة كأس العالم فالمغرب.

مع فائق الاحترام

links.mailtoBody:
À qui de droit,

Je vous écris au sujet du chien qui s'est effondré des suites d'un coup de chaleur dans la soirée du 20 juin 2026, pendant la vague de chaleur, alors qu'il participait à des opérations de sécurité au pied de la tour Eiffel. L'incident a été filmé, largement diffusé et relayé à l'échelle internationale. La Société d'Exploitation de la tour Eiffel a déclaré qu'elle cherchait à comprendre ce qui s'était passé. À ce jour, cependant, aucune information confirmant l’état de santé de l’animal n’a été rendue publique.

Une société de sécurité privée intervenant sur le site a déclaré que le chien avait été examiné par un vétérinaire et qu’il allait bien. L’association de protection des animaux SEPA, qui a déposé une plainte officielle concernant cet incident, a indiqué qu’elle n’était pas en mesure de vérifier cette version des faits et qu’elle ignorait où se trouvait actuellement l’animal. Une assurance non vérifiée émanant d’une entreprise qui fait elle-même l’objet d’un examen minutieux ne peut raisonnablement être considérée comme une confirmation.

Je demande donc respectueusement à la Société d’Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel de publier une mise à jour claire sur l’état actuel et la localisation du chien, sous une forme pouvant être vérifiée de manière indépendante par la SEPA ou un vétérinaire qualifié.

Il s’agit d’une question simple à résoudre. Si l’animal s’est rétabli, une confirmation en ce sens réglerait la question. Si ce n’est pas le cas, le public a un intérêt légitime à savoir ce qui s’est passé dans l’enceinte de l’un des monuments les plus visités au monde.

Une plainte pénale a été déposée suite à cet incident, et le Conseil national des activités privées de sécurité (CNAPS) en a été informé. Je vous serais reconnaissant de bien vouloir me répondre dans les plus brefs délais.

Cordialement,



L’équipe @HallieForAnimals
contact@hallieforanimals.org




To whom it may concern,

I am writing regarding the dog that collapsed from heat exhaustion on the evening of 20 June 2026, during the heatwave, while being used in security operations at the foot of the Eiffel Tower. The incident was filmed, widely shared, and reported internationally. The Société d'Exploitation de la tour Eiffel has stated that it is seeking to understand what took place. To date, however, no confirmation of the animal's condition has been made public.

A private security firm operating on the site has stated that the dog was seen by a veterinarian and is well. The animal-protection association SEPA, which has lodged a formal complaint over the incident, has stated that it is unable to verify this account and does not know the animal's current whereabouts. An unverified assurance from a company that is itself subject to scrutiny cannot reasonably be treated as confirmation.

I therefore respectfully request that the Société d'Exploitation de la tour Eiffel publish a clear update on the dog's current condition and location, in a form that can be independently verified by SEPA or a qualified veterinarian.

This is a straightforward matter to resolve. If the animal has recovered, confirmation to that effect would settle the question. If it has not, the public has a legitimate interest in knowing what occurred on the grounds of one of the most visited monuments in the world.

A criminal complaint has been filed in connection with the incident, and the Conseil national des activités privées de sécurité (CNAPS) has been notified. I would be grateful for a prompt response.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
致相关负责人：

我特此致函，正式要求立即且永久终止每年一度的玉林荔枝与狗肉节，以及中国境内所有以供人类食用为目的的商业性犬类屠宰活动。
该节日涉及极端残忍的虐待动物行为，包括殴打、活煮和折磨狗只，其中许多是遭盗窃的宠物。这些行为不仅在国内和国际上广受谴责，损害了中国的国际形象，也与日益发展的动物福利和公共卫生标准相悖。
我敦促全国人民代表大会、相关部委及监管机构采取以下具体行动：

永久取消玉林节及所有类似活动
在全国范围内禁止商业性屠宰和销售狗肉
执行更严格的法律，打击盗窃宠物和虐待动物行为
推行符合现代动物福利标准的政策

中国有机会通过终结这一过时且残酷的习俗来展现领导力。中国许多城市和公民已经摒弃了食用狗肉的习惯。现在是采取国家层面行动的时候了。
我强烈敦促您就此问题果断采取行动。
感谢您的关注。

此致，



@HallieForAnimals 团队
contact@hallieforanimals.org


To whom it may concern,

I am writing to formally demand an immediate and permanent end to the annual Yulin Lychee and Dog Meat Festival and all commercial dog slaughter for human consumption in China.
The festival involves extreme animal cruelty, including the beating, boiling, and torture of dogs, many of which are stolen pets. These practices are widely condemned both domestically and internationally, damage China’s global image, and conflict with evolving standards of animal welfare and public health.
I urge the National People’s Congress, relevant ministries, and regulatory bodies to take concrete action by:

Permanently canceling the Yulin festival and all similar events
Implementing a nationwide ban on the commercial slaughter and sale of dog meat
Enforcing stricter laws against pet theft and animal cruelty
Promoting policies that reflect modern animal welfare standards

China has the opportunity to show leadership by ending this outdated and cruel practice. Many Chinese cities and citizens have already moved away from dog meat consumption. It is time for national-level action.
I strongly urge you to act decisively on this matter.
Thank you for your attention.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
A quien corresponda:

Les escribo en relación con el caso de Derlis Antonio López Mereles (27), acusado de maltrato animal y violencia doméstica en Presidente Franco. Se le acusa de haber arrojado violentamente al suelo a un gatito indefenso, lo que le causó la muerte.
Este acto brutal ha causado indignación generalizada. Como ciudadano preocupado que aboga por el bienestar animal y la justicia, insto respetuosamente a lo siguiente:

1. Que se aplique la pena máxima prevista por la ley paraguaya para el maltrato animal (Ley 6524/2020 y estatutos relacionados).
2. Que se tome plenamente en cuenta el contexto de violencia doméstica denunciado.
3. Una actualización pública sobre el estado del caso, la detención y el cronograma del proceso judicial.
4. Un mensaje público contundente de que no se tolerará el maltrato animal.

Se trataba solo de un gatito pequeño e inocente. Este tipo de casos exigen la respuesta más firme para proteger a los animales vulnerables y disuadir la violencia en el futuro.
Gracias por su atención y su compromiso con la justicia.

Prueba en video: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zZht2K4TbJCHkYNMKSdwUwZ2FcBM_6g-/view?usp=sharing

Atentamente,



Equipo de @HallieForAnimals
contact@hallieforanimals.org


To whom it may concern,

I am writing regarding the case of Derlis Antonio López Mereles (27), charged with animal cruelty and domestic violence in Presidente Franco. He is accused of violently throwing a defenseless kitten to the ground, resulting in its death.
This brutal act has caused widespread outrage. As a concerned citizen advocating for animal welfare and justice, I respectfully urge:

1. The maximum legal penalty under Paraguayan law for animal cruelty (Law 6524/2020 and related statutes).
2. Full consideration of the reported domestic violence context.
3. A public update on the case status, arrest, and prosecution timeline.
4. A strong public message that animal abuse will not be tolerated.

This was only a small, innocent kitten. Such cases demand the strongest response to protect vulnerable animals and deter future violence.
Thank you for your attention and commitment to justice.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zZht2K4TbJCHkYNMKSdwUwZ2FcBM_6g-/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.title: Demand Animal Welfare Laws in China
links.mailtoSubject: 在中国颁布一部全面的国家动物福利法/Enact a Comprehensive National Animal Welfare Law in China
links.description:
𝐒𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞-𝐜𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐤 𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐥 𝐢𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐛𝐢𝐨 𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐝 "𝐃𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐧𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐥 𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐟𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐋𝐚𝐰𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐚"❗️

As of today, China has no national law against animal cruelty.
In 2009, a team of Chinese legal scholars, led by a professor at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, wrote a comprehensive animal protection bill. That bill has still not been enacted.
In a 2025 survey published by China's Ministry of Justice, 96% of respondents backed a national anti-cruelty law.
In January 2026, a separate group of Chinese scholars, lawyers and campaigners met in Beijing and submitted a fresh appeal to the National People's Congress, calling for the same reform their colleagues first drafted in 2009.
Two generations of Chinese experts asking for the same law.
The people of China have asked for this. Their lawmakers have not delivered it.
It's time the PEOPLE's Republic of China listens to the people.

#china #animallover

links.mailtoBody:
致相关负责人：

我谨此致函，恳请全国人民代表大会及相关部委在中华人民共和国制定一部全面的《动物保护法》。

这一呼吁并非基于中国价值观之外的立场，而是为了支持中国公众已经明确表达的意愿。在司法部发布的2025年调查中，96%的受访者支持制定国家层面的反虐待动物法。2026年1月，中国法学家、律师和活动人士召开了“北京动物法论坛”，并向全国人民代表大会提交了正式请愿书，呼吁进行这项改革。中华人民共和国人民已经发出了清晰的声音；我只是在此加入自己的声音，以支持他们的诉求。

中国已经奠定了基础，包括实验动物标准、野生动物保护，以及2026年1月1日生效的修订版《治安管理处罚法》中加强的宠物相关处罚规定。一部专门的国家法律将在这些基础上，针对所有情境——包括农场动物、伴侣动物及其他动物——建立明确的保护措施，防止不必要的虐待。

此类立法将：

1. 支持农业的可持续与高质量发展
2. 提升公共卫生和食品安全水平
3. 巩固中国作为一个富有同情心且具有前瞻性的国家的国际形象
4. 践行中国人民的意愿，弘扬人与动物和谐共处、相互关怀的传统价值观

该法律的首份专家起草稿于2009年制定。十六年过去了，鉴于公众对此事的支持如此强烈，我谨此敦促将此事列为立法议程的优先事项，并听取农业农村部的意见。这项改革将获得广泛的公众支持，并标志着中国在这方面的重大进步。

感谢您抽出时间审阅此信。

此致，



@HallieForAnimals 团队
contact@hallieforanimals.org




To whom it may concern,

I am writing to respectfully urge the National People's Congress and relevant ministries to enact a comprehensive Animal Welfare Law in the People's Republic of China.

This appeal is not made from outside China's values, but in support of what the Chinese public has already made clear it wants. In a 2025 survey published by the Ministry of Justice, 96% of respondents supported a national anti-cruelty law. In January 2026, Chinese legal scholars, lawyers and campaigners convened the Beijing Animal Law Forum and submitted a formal appeal to the National People's Congress calling for exactly this reform. The people of the People's Republic have spoken with a clear voice; I am simply adding mine in support of theirs.

China has already laid the groundwork — standards for laboratory animals, wildlife protection, and the strengthened pet-related penalties introduced under the revised Law on Penalties for the Administration of Public Security that took effect on 1 January 2026. A dedicated national law would build on these foundations by establishing clear protections against unnecessary cruelty across all contexts: farm animals, companion animals, and others.

Such legislation would:

1. Support sustainable and high-quality agricultural development
2. Enhance public health and food safety
3. Strengthen China's international standing as a compassionate and forward-looking nation
4. Honour the will of the Chinese public and the traditional values of harmony and care between people and animals

The first expert draft of such a law was produced in 2009. Sixteen years on, with public support this overwhelming, I respectfully urge that the matter be prioritised on the legislative agenda, with input from the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs. This reform would enjoy broad public support and represent a significant advancement for China.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
致相关负责人：

我们敦促贵国政府对中国施加外交和执法压力，要求其取缔那些制作和传播极端虐待动物内容的有组织网络，尤其是针对猫和幼猫的“定制虐猫视频”。

这些网络主要以中国为基地，通过有偿委托和二次上传，将血腥暴力内容传播至全球各地。仅靠删除内容远远不够——必须从源头进行执法。
这是一项严重的儿童安全与公共安全问题。相当比例的青少年曾在网上接触过虐待动物的内容，而虐待动物已被充分证实是针对人类暴力行为（包括家庭暴力及其他严重犯罪）的预测指标。

我们呼吁贵国政府敦促中国立即采取行动：

1：查明、逮捕并起诉猫咪虐待内容的组织者、制作者及委托人。
2：将这些网络视为严重的犯罪组织。
3：开展国际合作，切断其资金来源并阻断传播渠道。

必须将此视为一个跨国儿童安全与暴力预防问题加以处理。
感谢您的关注。

此致，



@HallieForAnimals 团队
contact@hallieforanimals.org



To whom it may concern,

We urge your government to apply diplomatic and law-enforcement pressure on China to dismantle organised online networks producing and distributing extreme animal cruelty content, especially torture-to-order videos targeting cats and kittens.

These networks are primarily based in China and export graphic violence globally through paid commissions and reuploads. Content removal alone is insufficient — enforcement at the source is essential.
This is a serious child safety and public safety issue. A significant percentage of young people have been exposed to animal cruelty online, and animal abuse is a well-documented predictor of violence against humans (including domestic abuse and other serious crimes).

We call on your government to press China for immediate action:

1: Identify, arrest, and prosecute organisers, producers, and commissioners of cat torture content.
2: Treat these networks as serious criminal enterprises.
3: Cooperate internationally to disrupt funding and distribution.

This must be addressed as a transnational child safety and violence prevention issue.
Thank you for your attention.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
İlgili makamlara,

26 Haziran 2026 tarihinde Avcılar’daki Denizköşkler plajında, basında H.E. olarak adı geçen bir adam köpeğine defalarca vurduğu bildirildi. Görüntülerde, adamın hayvanı kayalıklara sürüklediği ve çocukların gözü önünde köpeğin çığlık atmasına rağmen uzun bir süre boyunca ona vurmaya devam ettiği görülüyor. Adam gözaltına alınarak tutuklandı; köpek ise koruma altına alındı.

Bu durum, 5199 sayılı Hayvanları Koruma Kanunu’nun 28/A maddesi kapsamında bir evcil hayvana yönelik işkence ve zalimane, acımasız muamele niteliğindedir ve altı aydan üç yıla kadar hapis cezası öngörülmektedir.

Saygılarımızla aşağıdakileri talep ediyoruz:

1: Davanın, idari para cezasına indirgenmemesi ve 28/A maddesi uyarınca cezai suç olarak yargılanması.
2: Tarım ve Ormancılık Bakanlığı’nın il/ilçe müdürlüğünün, 28/A(8) maddesi uyarınca Başsavcıya yazılı sevk belgesini düzenlemesi ve teyit etmesi.
3: Yasal aralık dahilinde azami cezanın, hüküm erteleme (HAGB) ve cezanın infazının askıya alınması olmaksızın verilmesi.
4: Yargılama süresince tutukluluğun devam ettirilmesi.
5: Köpeğin suçluya iade edilmemesi ve güvenli bir şekilde başka bir aileye verilmesi.

Bu olay kamuoyunda büyük bir öfkeye neden olmuştur. Adaletin, gerçek bir caydırıcı unsur olarak yerine getirilmesini bekliyoruz.

Video kanıtı: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OJSk_SgEW-dRoCam_bUApREZirulH3nh/view?usp=sharing

Saygılarımızla,



@HallieForAnimals Ekibi
contact@hallieforanimals.org


To whom it may concern,

On 26 June 2026 at Denizköşkler beach in Avcılar, a man reported in the press as H.E. beat his dog repeatedly. Footage shows him dragging the animal into the rocks and continuing to strike it for an extended period as it cried out, while children watched. He has been detained and remanded; the dog has been taken into protection.

This is torture and cruel, brutal treatment of a pet under Article 28/A of Animal Protection Law No. 5199, which carries six months to three years' imprisonment.

We respectfully request:

1: That the case be prosecuted as a criminal offence under Article 28/A, not reduced to an administrative fine.
2: That the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry's provincial/district directorate file and confirm the written referral to the Chief Public Prosecutor under Article 28/A(8).
3: That the maximum sentence within the statutory range be imposed, with no deferral of verdict (HAGB) and no suspension.
4: That pre-trial detention be maintained for the duration of proceedings.
5: That the dog not be returned to the offender, and be safely rehomed.

This case has caused wide public outrage. We expect justice to be delivered as a genuine deterrent.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OJSk_SgEW-dRoCam_bUApREZirulH3nh/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I'm writing regarding footage circulating publicly showing a Valley Public High School bus striking a dog sleeping in the road and continuing on without stopping to check on the animal.

I'm asking:

1: Valley Public High School conduct an internal review of the driver's conduct and proceed with necessary disciplinary action.
2: Kathmandu Valley Traffic Police formally investigate the incident as a hit-and-run involving a public vehicle, consistent with Nepal's Animal Health and Livestock Services Act provisions on cruelty to animals.
3: Both parties issue a public response addressing the incident.

There were children on that bus. Whatever the driver's reasons for not stopping, the lesson those students just absorbed is that a living creature's suffering isn't worth thirty seconds of your time if you're in a hurry. That's not a lesson any school should be comfortable teaching by default, and I'd expect Valley Public to want to correct the record, for the driver's conduct and for what its students take from it.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/18WwUp5pEXHVsvxmW7aG1_-6Tk75kiutB/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing regarding the ongoing police operations against scam "rescue" shelters in Mityana.

Reports confirm that dogs are being killed during these raids. These animals have already suffered deliberate injury, starvation, neglect, and cruelty at the hands of the scammers exposed by the BBC Africa Eye investigation. They must not now become additional victims of the operations meant to stop the abuse.

We demand immediate action to:

1: Prioritize the humane rescue and protection of all dogs in these operations. No further unnecessary killings or euthanasia without transparent veterinary justification and independent oversight.
2: Coordinate directly with legitimate Ugandan animal welfare organizations on the ground to ensure every dog receives proper veterinary care, food, shelter, and rehabilitation.
3: Provide full transparency on any dogs killed during raids, including exact circumstances and reasons.
4: Aggressively prosecute the scammers for animal cruelty while ensuring the animals they exploited are safeguarded, not destroyed.

The eyes of the world are on Uganda. These dogs have endured enough. Further deaths are unacceptable and will damage Uganda’s reputation.

We require an immediate response detailing the steps being taken to stop the killings and protect the remaining dogs.

This matter is urgent.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yhpJWjobvlOrKoQlqot3TdvArBucjM_E/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am formally requesting an immediate welfare check and full investigation into suspected animal cruelty and neglect involving Adam Rabinowitz/Fein (TrueCare for Pets, Tarzana, associated with 18110 Killion St #6).

Key details on the recent Odin case (per the owner's account): The owner dropped Odin off with Mr. Rabinowitz. Mr. Rabinowitz later called the owner stating Odin was not moving and his back legs were paralyzed. The owner took Odin to the ER, where he was diagnosed with severe internal bleeding and hind leg paralysis. Mr. Rabinowitz claimed it was from a dog fight, but the injuries are not consistent with a dog fight and are instead consistent with blunt force trauma. Odin died as a result.

Additional ongoing concerns include reports of a strong odor emitting from the garage where Adam houses dogs, with water leaking into the area while dogs are present. There are also broader reports of large group handling (20+ dogs), unsafe transport, and prior community incidents.

Requested actions:

1: Immediate welfare check at the property and any locations where dogs are kept.
2: Full investigation into animal neglect and cruelty regarding Odin and the overall operation.
3: Public statement on case progression and findings to assure the community.

Thank you for treating this with the urgency it deserves to protect animals in Tarzana.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1KUjSYei-5xHJ7UO-HEp3F7i3UNeHFLVe/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

To whom it may concern,

I am writing to request a welfare check on animals at the residence of Patrick Vaneck, reportedly located on Meadows Street in Bakersfield, CA.

Public video footage (originally posted by Mr. Vaneck himself) appears to show Mr. Vaneck dragging a dog by the neck across a field while yelling at it after the dog ran off and chased cows. The handler’s frustration and method of correction raise concerns about potential neglect in training and the use of excessive force that could cause injury or distress to the animal.

Community members have expressed worry that, despite these incidents being public, Mr. Vaneck has reportedly been allowed to adopt or keep additional dogs. This heightens concern for the ongoing welfare of any animals in his care.

I respectfully urge Kern County Animal Services and Sheriff's Office to conduct a prompt welfare check and assess whether proper training, restraint, and humane treatment standards are being met. California law prohibits animal cruelty and neglect, and I believe an official review is warranted to ensure the dogs’ safety.

Thank you for your important work protecting animals.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AYWzwGkIZwCqZMPfquLSvBdXv9UNMTYl/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,

Către cine este interesat,

Vă scriu în legătură cu dosarul penal împotriva lui Gheorghe Ciuleandra, anchetat pentru uciderea intenționată și ilegală a unui câine într-o zonă împădurită din apropierea localității Zosin, acuzat în temeiul articolului 25 alineatul (3) litera (a) din Legea nr. 205/2004.

Imaginile difuzate public documentează un act de cruzime extremă și prelungită împotriva unui animal imobilizat, care nu avea nicio posibilitate de a se apăra. Suspectul are o condamnare anterioară pentru violență, ceea ce, în opinia mea, confirmă un tipar de comportament periculos pentru comunitate.

Vă solicit respectuos:

1: Să finalizați ancheta fără întârziere, fără a reclasifica infracțiunea într-o categorie inferioară;
2: Să trimiteți dosarul în judecată sub acuzația care reflectă adevărata gravitate a faptei, conform art. 25 alin. (3) lit. (a);
3: Să pledați, în fața instanței, pentru pedeapsa maximă permisă de lege, împreună cu pedeapsa complementară constând în interdicția maximă permisă de a deține animale.

Cazuri precum acesta, lăsate fără o reacție judiciară proporțională, transmit un mesaj greșit comunității. Vă mulțumesc pentru atenția acordată acestei solicitări — sper că justiția va reflecta gravitatea faptelor comise.

Cu respect,

Echipa @HallieForAnimals
contact@hallieforanimals.org


To whom it may concern,

I am writing about the criminal case against Gheorghe Ciuleandra, under investigation for the intentional, unlawful killing of a dog in a wooded area near Zosin, charged under Article 25(3)(a) of Law 205/2004.

The publicly circulated footage documents an act of extreme, prolonged cruelty against a restrained animal that had no way to defend itself. The suspect has a prior conviction for violence, which in my view confirms a pattern of behavior dangerous to the community.

I respectfully request that you:

1: Complete the investigation promptly, without reclassifying the offense to a lesser category;
2: Send the case to trial under the charge that reflects the true severity of the act, per Art. 25(3)(a);
3: Argue, before the court, for the maximum penalty allowed by law, along with the complementary penalty of the maximum permitted ban on owning animals.

Cases like this, left without a proportionate judicial response, send the wrong message to the community. Thank you for your attention to this request — I hope justice reflects the severity of what was done.

Sincerely,

@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to demand the immediate registration of a First Information Report and a full investigation into an act of fatal cruelty against an animal that took place on the evening of 5 July 2026, at approximately 7:00 p.m., at Maa Bamleshwari Auto Center, Smriti Nagar, Bhilai, 490020.

According to eyewitness accounts and video documentation, a young street puppy that had entered the premises to shelter from the rain was beaten to death by men present at the establishment. This was not a momentary act — it was the deliberate killing of a defenceless animal that had sought refuge.

The intentional killing of an animal is a cognisable offence under Section 325 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, punishable with imprisonment of up to five years, and also an offence under Section 11 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960. Where more than one person acted together, Section 3(5) of the BNS (common intention) is also attracted.

I respectfully but firmly urge the Durg Police to:

1: Register an FIR under Section 325 BNS, 2023 and Section 11 PCA Act, 1960 without delay;
2: Secure and examine CCTV footage from the premises and surrounding area before it is overwritten or deleted;
3: Identify and question every individual present and involved;
4: Ensure the case is pursued to completion and not quietly closed.

Extensive research establishes that cruelty of this kind is a documented predictor of violence against people. A firm response protects the residents of Bhilai as much as the animals.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/19EUg00uxJSLvdjzq-urkOACYkJLQhcxS/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

To whom it may concern,

At Street No. 2, Kaman No. 16, in front of Sanjeev Dairy, Noor Mahal, Bhopal, a man tied a black puppy's mouth shut and beat it repeatedly.

This is a cognizable offence under Section 325 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (imprisonment of up to five years) and Section 11 of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960.

I ask that an FIR be registered, that the person responsible be identified, that the puppy be seized under Section 35 of the PCA Act and given veterinary treatment, and that the matter be investigated and prosecuted according to law.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WxIbYcwzIMW68W11FmCPBbg2RtQi7nFd/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team

links.mailtoBody:
İlgili makamlara,

Sultanbeyli’deki bir işyerinde bir köpeğe uygulanan ve güvenlik kameraları tarafından kaydedilen işkence vakası hakkında yazıyorum; bu olayla ilgili olarak bir şüpheli (A.S.) tutuklanmış ve Maltepe Cezaevi’ne gönderilmiştir.

5199 sayılı Kanunun 28/A maddesi uyarınca Müdürlük’ün üstlendiği rol göz önünde bulundurularak, Müdürlükten, bu eylemin işkence / zalimane ve acımasız muamele olarak kovuşturulmasını desteklemesini ve uygun olduğu durumlarda yazılı şikayetçi olarak, 28/A maddesi uyarınca ağırlaştırıcı nedenin (hayvanın bakımından sorumlu olan fail) uygulanmasını, erteleme (HAGB), cezanın askıya alınması veya para cezasına çevrilmesini engelleyecek üst sınırda bir ceza verilmesini ve yargılama süresince tutukluluğun devam etmesini talep ediyorum.

Bu dava, kamuoyu ve uluslararası kamuoyunun dikkatini çekmektedir. 

Video kanıtı: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nBcZW0-C3QC5Hvf5LUNccSBdVZr271F-/view?usp=sharing

Saygılarımızla,



@HallieForAnimals Ekibi
contact@hallieforanimals.org




To whom it may concern,

I am writing regarding the documented torture of a dog at a workplace in Sultanbeyli, captured on security cameras, for which a suspect (A.S.) has been arrested and remanded to Maltepe Prison.

Given the Directorate's role under Article 28/A of Law No. 5199, I respectfully request that the Directorate support prosecution of this act as torture / cruel and brutal treatment, and, as a written complainant where appropriate, press for the Article 28/A aggravator (offender responsible for the animal's care), for a sentence in the upper range that precludes deferral (HAGB), suspension, or conversion to a fine, and for continued detention through trial.

This case is under public and international observation. 

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nBcZW0-C3QC5Hvf5LUNccSBdVZr271F-/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
İlgili makamlara,

Eskişehir’deki bir konut kompleksinin ortak alanından belediye ekipleri tarafından yakalanma sırasında bir köpeğe kaba muamele edildiğini gösteren görüntüler uluslararası ilgi gördü. Köpeğin hayatta kalması ve evlat ediniliyor olması sevindiricidir. Ancak mesele tek bir hayvan değil, bu işin nasıl yapıldığıdır.
Boynundan kaldırılan, sürüklenen ve yere bastırılan bir hayvan kendini savunacaktır. Isırırsa, “saldırgan” olarak sınıflandırılır. Değiştirilen 5199 sayılı Kanun uyarınca, bu sınıflandırma ölümcül sonuçlar doğurabilir. Hayvan, maruz kaldığı muamele nedeniyle cezalandırılmaktadır. Bu, kamu hizmetinde savunulabilir bir standart değildir.

5199 sayılı Kanun, hayvanlara acı, ıstırap ve sıkıntı verilmesini yasaklamaktadır. Bu nedenle şunları talep ediyoruz:

1: Bu yakalama olayıyla ilgili idari soruşturma açılması ve soruşturma sonuçlanana kadar olaya karışan görevlilerin saha görevinden uzaklaştırılması.
2: Yakalama protokolünün yazılı olarak yayınlanması — gerekli ekipman, gerekli teknik, gerekli eğitim.
3: Hayvanların boynundan kaldırılması ve sürüklenmesinin açıkça yasaklanması; tüm yakalama operasyonlarının zorunlu olarak kamerayla kaydedilmesi, kayıtların en az 90 gün süreyle saklanması ve talep üzerine erişime açılması.
4: Her hayvanın kabulü sırasında bağımsız bir veteriner muayenesi ve yazılı raporun düzenlenmesi ve bu raporların düzenli olarak yayınlanması.
5: Güç kullanıldığı bir yakalama sırasındaki davranışına dayanılarak hiçbir köpeğin “saldırgan” olarak sınıflandırılmayacağına dair yazılı taahhüt.

Bu maddeler İl Hayvan Koruma Kurulu’nun gündemine alınmalı ve alınan kararlar kamuoyuna açıklanmalıdır.

Video kanıtı: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ndG2kLdMXKiQGm5cPRxZZMaWTw8_HrVe/view?usp=sharing

Saygılarımızla,



@HallieForAnimals Ekibi
contact@hallieforanimals.org



To whom it may concern,

Footage of a dog being roughly handled during a municipal capture from the shared grounds of a residential complex in Eskişehir has drawn international attention. That the dog survived and is being adopted is welcome. But the issue is not one animal, it is how this work is done.
An animal hoisted by the neck, dragged, and pinned will defend itself. If it bites, it is classified as "aggressive." Under the amended Law No. 5199, that classification can be fatal. The animal is punished for the treatment it received. That is not a defensible standard of public service.

Law No. 5199 prohibits causing animals pain, suffering, and distress. We therefore ask for:

1: An administrative investigation into this capture, with the officers involved removed from field duty pending its outcome.
2: Publication of the written capture protocol — required equipment, required technique, required training.
3: An explicit ban on neck-hoisting and dragging; mandatory camera recording of all capture operations, retained at least 90 days and disclosable on request.
4: An independent veterinary examination and written report for every animal on intake, published on a regular basis.
5: A written commitment that no dog will be classified "aggressive" on the basis of behaviour during a capture in which force was used.

These should be placed on the agenda of the Provincial Animal Protection Board, with its decisions made public.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ndG2kLdMXKiQGm5cPRxZZMaWTw8_HrVe/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoBody:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a concerned citizen demanding an immediate, thorough, and transparent investigation into animal cruelty, neglect, and potential Criminal Code violations at the former F.A.B.R. (Fight Against Breed Racism / Jen Jefferies) property in Nanticoke, Ontario, following the recent eviction.

Publicly available videos, images, and eyewitness accounts from the site after eviction reveal dogs living in filthy, inhumane conditions, with living animals abandoned, deceased dogs, carcasses, bones, apparent burial sites, and a burned dog whose injuries appear separate from and more recent than the barn fire that occurred months ago. This situation persisted despite prior PAWS involvement following that barn fire, during which authorities were made aware of unsuitable housing structures and welfare concerns. The fact that these conditions continued under oversight raises grave questions about the effectiveness of monitoring and enforcement, allowing unnecessary pain, suffering, and injury to animals in violation of the Provincial Animal Welfare Services Act and especially Criminal Code Section 445.1(1)(a): every person commits an offence who wilfully causes or, being the owner, wilfully permits to be caused unnecessary pain, suffering or injury to an animal.

The localized burn damage on the dog, confined to the animal and immediate ground rather than the structure, further demands forensic examination, including necropsies on deceased animals, full site inspection, removal of any remaining animals, and a criminal probe by police alongside PAWS to determine timelines, responsibility, and whether criminal acts occurred. This is not an isolated welfare matter but evidence of ongoing failures that have cost animal lives.

We expect prompt and decisive action: entry onto the property, seizure of evidence, veterinary assessments, and public updates on the case. The public is watching and documenting this closely to ensure accountability.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14dwoEsjdi5hJikaPb5KuqViQJOQF0OjG/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

links.mailtoSubject: 在中国颁布一部全面的国家动物福利法/Enact a Comprehensive National Animal Welfare Law in China
links.description:
𝐒𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞-𝐜𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐤 𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐥 𝐢𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐛𝐢𝐨 𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐀𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐝 "𝐒𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐂𝐚𝐭 𝐓𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬" & "𝐃𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐧𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐥 𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐟𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐋𝐚𝐰𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐚"❗️

This barely scratches the surface of what is currently being filmed, shared, and profited from in China. Videos of cats being microwaved, blended, vivisected, cattle prodded, and beaten with hammers are being sold and even commissioned by Chinese cat torture rings.

Kids are being exposed to extreme animal torture content, cats and kittens abused for entertainment, status, and in some cases, paid commissioning.
Reports claim 43% of 16–17 year olds have witnessed animal cruelty online. A generation is being conditioned to tolerate suffering.

These cruelty rings don’t survive because the internet is “too big to police.”
They survive because the source is allowed to operate, and the content is then exported globally through reuploads and private channels.
As of today, there are zero animal welfare laws in China. In 2006, a comprehensive animal welfare bill was drafted, but the Chinese government refused to move it forward.

Animal cruelty is a known red flag for human violence.
Research into school massacres found 43% of perpetrators had histories of animal cruelty before the attacks.
A study of 150 adult males arrested for animal cruelty/neglect/animal sexual abuse found 96% had other criminal charges in their histories.

Torture content → desensitisation → escalation → harm to people

China must shut these networks down at the source.
Not “investigate.” Not “monitor.” Not “condemn.”
Arrest, prosecute, and dismantle.

#china #cutecats #kittens

links.mailtoBody:
致相关负责人：

作为一名关注此事的全球公民，我谨此致函，恳请全国人民代表大会及相关部委在中华人民共和国制定一部全面的《动物福利法》。

中国在动物相关法规方面已采取了重要举措，包括制定实验动物标准、野生动物保护规定，以及发表声明，承认动物福利是现代农业发展、食品安全和社会进步的重要组成部分。一部专门的国家法律将在这些基础上更进一步，针对所有情境、农场动物、伴侣动物及其他动物，确立明确的保护措施，防止不必要的虐待行为，同时促进人道标准的落实。

此类立法将：

1：支持可持续、高质量的农业发展
2：提升公共卫生和食品安全水平
3：强化中国作为一个富有同情心且具有前瞻性的国家的积极国际形象
4：顺应日益增长的公众期待，以及中国传统中“和谐”与“关爱”的价值观

恳请将此事项列为全国人民代表大会立法议程的优先事项，并听取农业农村部的意见。我相信这项改革将获得广泛支持，并标志着中国在该领域取得重大进步。

感谢您的时间。

此致，



@HallieForAnimals 团队
contact@hallieforanimals.org



To whom it may concern,

I am writing as a concerned global citizen to respectfully urge the National People's Congress and relevant ministries to enact a comprehensive Animal Welfare Law in the People's Republic of China.

China has already taken important steps in animal-related regulations, including standards for laboratory animals, wildlife protection, and statements recognizing animal welfare as part of modern agricultural development, food safety, and societal progress. A dedicated national law would build on these foundations by establishing clear protections against unnecessary cruelty across all contexts, farm animals, companion animals, and others, while promoting humane standards.

Such legislation would:

1: Support sustainable and high-quality agricultural development
2: Enhance public health and food safety
3: Strengthen China's positive international image as a compassionate and forward-looking nation
4: Align with growing public expectations and traditional Chinese values of harmony and care

I kindly request that this matter be prioritized in the legislative agenda of the National People's Congress, with input from the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs. I believe this reform would enjoy broad support and represent a significant advancement for China.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,



@HallieForAnimals Team
contact@hallieforanimals.org

İlgili makamlara,

15 Temmuz 2026 tarihinde saat 20:23 civarında, Samsun’un Canik ilçesi, Derebahçe Mahallesi, Şehit Mustafa Zıvalı Bulvarı No:65 önünde tanık olduğum kasıtlı hayvan zulmü eylemi konusunda önlem alınmasını talep etmek amacıyla bu mektubu yazıyorum. Bir erkeğin sokak kedisine kasten tekme attığı ve ardından hayvanı yaralı halde bırakarak uzaklaştığı görüldü.

Bu, bir hayvana karşı kasıtlı bir zulüm eylemi olup, 7332 sayılı Kanun (2021) ile cezaları ağırlaştırılan 5199 sayılı Hayvanları Koruma Kanunu’na aykırıdır. Sokak hayvanları devletin ve belediyenin koruması altındadır ve bu durum cezasız kalamaz.

Kurumunuzdan aşağıdakileri talep ediyorum:

1: Gecikmeden soruşturma açın.
2: Bulvar boyunca bulunan CCTV ve yakındaki işyerlerinin kameralarını da inceleyerek sorumlu kişiyi tespit edin.
3: Yaralı kedinin yerini belirleyin ve veteriner bakımı sağlayın.
4: Yasa kapsamında öngörülen tüm idari ve cezai yaptırımları uygulayın ve konuyu Savcılığa sevk edin.

Video kanıtı: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1vn5j0uXLAEslYamZKvv0XDnR8Uqp_cmb/view?usp=sharing

Saygılarımızla,



@HallieForAnimals Ekibi
contact@hallieforanimals.org



To whom it may concern,

I am writing to demand action on an act of deliberate animal cruelty witnessed at approximately 20:23 on 15 July 2026, outside Şehit Mustafa Zıvalı Bulvarı No:65, Derebahçe Mahallesi, Canik, Samsun. A man was seen maliciously kicking a street cat and then walking away, leaving the animal injured.

This is a deliberate act of cruelty against an animal and a violation of the Animal Protection Law No. 5199, including the penalties strengthened under Law No. 7332 (2021). Street animals fall under the protection of the state and the municipality, and this cannot go unanswered.

I call on your office to:

1: Open an investigation without delay.
2: Identify the individual responsible, including through review of CCTV and nearby business cameras along the boulevard.
3: Locate the injured cat and provide veterinary care.
4: Apply the full administrative and criminal penalties available under the law, and refer the matter to the Public Prosecutor.

Video evidence: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1vn5j0uXLAEslYamZKvv0XDnR8Uqp_cmb/view?usp=sharing

Sincerely,
